verdict.rationale: BVNK documents API key generation in the Portal and Hawk request signing, but nothing in the evidence shows scopes, permission limits, or restricted keys for least-privilege agent access. The agent-wallet-cli probe only establishes that a CLI exists and says nothing about scoped credentials. Plain key generation is an adjacent feature and earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
